An array represents a list of elements; a tuple describes known positions with potentially different types.
Array එකක list එJක් item types නියම කරනවා. Tuple එJක් position එකට අදාළ type එක Jවන
Product prices form an array; coordinates or an id/name pair can be tuples.
Read the diagram: The left list accepts numbers at any index; the right has a known first string and second number.

Interview question: How is a tuple different from an array?
Answer: It describes specific positions and their types, with known required length.
